newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline drops with crude, arb clouds picture.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline drops with crude, arb clouds picture.

text.p: NWE gasoline edged $1 a tonne lower with crude oil but the arbitrage to the U.S. clouded this week's outlook, traders said.
"I would say it's questionable," depending on size and delivery period, said one trader.

But he said he was "relatively positive" on gasoline due to some refinery turnarounds in the U.S. and the contango in the European market, which makes it cheaper to buy and store inventories ahead of spring.
Eurograde barges traded at $217 fob ARA while regular unleaded in thinner activity was also down $1 at $207/$209.

Some traders said the arbitrage and high freight rates were limiting trans-Atlantic deals -- after lively activity in the first half of the month -- and that may depress Northwest Europe prices for now.
